name: Montana
overview: Montana FWP draws limited deer and elk permits, Deer B and Elk B licenses, all antelope licenses, and moose, bighorn sheep and mountain goat licenses using bonus points that are squared before the drawing ((points x points) + 1 chances, first choice only). Most nonresidents must first draw a General Big Game, Elk or Deer Combination license, 75% of which go to applicants with the most preference points and 25% at random to applicants with none. Nonresidents are limited to, but not guaranteed, 10% of each drawing's quota, and up to 15% of deer, elk and antelope quotas are reserved for landowner preference.

species.drawSystemSummary: Residents buy a General Elk License over the counter; limited elk permits (bulls/either-sex in restricted districts) and Elk B (antlerless) licenses are drawn using squared bonus points. FWP squares bonus points before the drawing: an applicant gets (points x points) + 1 chances, and bonus points apply to first-choice applications only.
species.residentNote: Residents must hold a current General Elk License to apply for an elk permit. Up to 15% of final quotas are set aside for landowner preference in the Deer Permit, Elk Permit, Deer B, Elk B, Antelope and Antelope B drawings; nonresidents are limited to, but not guaranteed, 10% of a drawing's quota.
species.nonresidentNote: Most nonresidents must first draw a General Big Game (deer and elk, 17,000 issued), Elk, or Deer (4,600 issued) Combination license (apply by April 1); 75% go to applicants with the most preference points (max 3) and 25% are drawn at random among applicants with no preference points. Elk and deer permits require applying for a combination license. Combination licenses use preference points, not bonus points.
species.otcSummary: Resident General Elk License over the counter ($20); some Elk B licenses are sold over the counter beginning June 15 in specific districts.

species.drawSystemSummary: The Black Bear License is sold over the counter and valid statewide; in 2026 FWP added black bear permits (510-20, 520-20) drawn with bonus points, which let holders keep hunting those BMUs after the harvest quota is met.
species.residentNote: Black Bear License $19; permit application $5. First-time buyers must pass the Black Bear Identification Test.
species.otcSummary: Black Bear License over the counter (either-sex, all BMUs, subject to BMU harvest quotas).

species.drawSystemSummary: For 2026 the lion regulations list a single over-the-counter Mountain Lion License per hunter (buy by Feb. 28, 2027), valid subject to LMU harvest quotas; there is no limited-lion drawing, and FWP had posted no 2026 limited-lion drawing statistics as of 2026-10-31. Through 2025 FWP issued Limited Mountain Lion licenses in some LMUs by a drawing with squared bonus points; the 2022-2025 Limited Mountain Lion drawing results kept here are history only (pastDrawSystem) and do not apply to the 2026 over-the-counter license.
species.nonresidentNote: Mountain Lion License $320; a $250 Nonresident Hound License (by drawing) is needed to hunt with dogs.
species.otcSummary: 2026: Mountain Lion License over the counter (one per hunter), valid subject to LMU quotas.

keyDates.label: Mountain Lion License purchase deadline (2026 license)
keyDates.note: FWP: "Even though the 2026 mountain lion season extends into the 2027 license year, the deadline to purchase 2026 licenses is February 28, 2027."

species.drawSystemSummary: Turkey licenses (General and regional) are sold over the counter; FWP published no turkey drawing statistics after 2021.
species.nonresidentNote: Turkey license $115 ($57.50 with an Upland Game Bird or Combination license). Nonresidents on public land and hunting-access-program land start later (spring Apr. 25, fall Sep. 11 in 2026).
species.otcSummary: General Turkey License over the counter, plus regional licenses (Regions 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7).

coverage.notes: Elk permits and Elk B licenses (FWP drawing statistics + detailed bonus point reports), first choice, 2022-2026; plus the nonresident General Big Game/Elk Combination preference-point summary (huntCode NR-BIGGAME-ELK-COMBO). 2022 elk permit reports are FWP's 'Original Drawing'. Resident/nonresident = regular pool; landowner-preference pool in each row note. Units = hunting districts under which FWP's regulations list the license (many licenses are valid only in portions of those districts).

Deer permits and Deer B licenses classified as mule deer by FWP's regulations text or report quota type, 2022-2026; permit 455-60 (mule deer or white-tailed deer) appears in both deer files; NR General Deer Combination summary (NR-DEER-COMBO) appears in both deer files. Units = hunting districts under which FWP's regulations list the license (many licenses are valid only in portions of those districts).

Deer permits and Deer B licenses classified as white-tailed deer by FWP's regulations text or report quota type, 2022-2026; see mule-deer note for shared records. Units = hunting districts under which FWP's regulations list the license (many licenses are valid only in portions of those districts).

Antelope, Antelope B and archery-only (900-20; 399-20 from 2026) licenses, 2022-2026. FWP's statewide ANY-DISABLED antelope row is omitted (incomplete columns in the report); it accounts for the gap between the sum of districts and FWP's statewide totals. Units = hunting districts under which FWP's regulations list the license (many licenses are valid only in portions of those districts).

Moose licenses 2022-2026. 2022 descriptions come from the report only (2022 MSGB regulations not in FWP's online archive). Units = hunting districts under which FWP's regulations list the license (many licenses are valid only in portions of those districts).

Limited bighorn sheep licenses 2022-2026 (unlimited licenses are not drawn and have no drawing statistics). Units = hunting districts under which FWP's regulations list the license (many licenses are valid only in portions of those districts).
Mountain goat licenses 2022-2026. Units = hunting districts under which FWP's regulations list the license (many licenses are valid only in portions of those districts).
Black bear permits 510-20 and 520-20, first offered in 2026. Units = hunting districts under which FWP's regulations list the license (many licenses are valid only in portions of those districts).

Limited mountain lion licenses 2022-2025. No 2026 limited-lion drawing statistics were posted by FWP as of 2026-10-31. Units = hunting districts under which FWP's regulations list the license (many licenses are valid only in portions of those districts).

No drawing: turkey licenses are over the counter; FWP's last spring turkey drawing statistics are for 2021 (outside 2022-2026). Units = hunting districts under which FWP's regulations list the license (many licenses are valid only in portions of those districts).
